evidence.description: Stacks of paperwork from this business found in a stolen U-Haul when Kent police were dispatched on 31 Mar 2023 to a report of a stolen parked U-Haul

unknowns: how the U-Haul relates to the Jeep used in the August and September incidents
notes: Cafe in Renton. The burglary date is not reported; the paperwork was found before 31 Mar 2023, so the burglary came earlier. The article calls this business a burglary victim. Renton detectives cite burglary cases since Oct 2022 across the wider series. Numbered first because the burglary predates the August incidents.
